strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break that level, form a fair value gap, retest back into the FVG, and get the retest candle engulfed before entering long or short in the direction of the break.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the area traded into the fair value gap with one tick of breathing room, and take profits at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target. Do not micromanage after entry.

variants.timeframe_note: Start on 5-minute chart for levels, then use 1-minute chart for direction/entry confirmation
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for FVG retest and engulfing candle before entry
variants.transcript_quote: we're going to start on our five-minute chart... switch to the 1 minute chart... wait for a retest of the fair value gap... we wait for this retest-cs

strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_limit_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle, then switch to the 5-minute chart, wait for price to create a fair value gap, and place a passive limit order directly on the FVG once price trades back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Put the stop at the first candle in the fair value gap pattern, just under that candle, and use a fixed 2:1 target. The trade is left to play out without micromanagement.

variants.variant_label: 15-minute opening candle + 5-minute FVG limit entry, 2:1 day trade
